Name: Alex's Animated Jack'O Lantern
Author: Alexsir94
Description:
[i]A fiery-eyed pumpkin glows in the dark, it's burning eyes flickering with eerie warmth but the shadows reveals a wicked grin, it's is Halloween.
[/i]
This mod alters the Jack'O Lantern item and is a small test of animating sprites in Stardew Valley, I'm uploading it as I might expand the mod later, also it's spooky season.

Install [with Content Patcher]:
- Find your Stardew Valley folder
﻿On Steam right click Stardew Valley > Manage > Browse Local Files,
in this folder go to > Mods
- Unzip or extract the downloaded folder here
- There should now be a folder named "[CP] Alex's Animated Jack'O Lantern" in the Mods folder
- Done!
